I loved the coop campaign in the first 3 gears of war. It looks like they didn't fuck with the core gameplay any but I view that as a good thing. I just wonder if people will still be excited about it even though it doesn't look like a huge evolution in the series to me.

I agree. There's only so long you can play a series - even a good one - before you move on to other things. And I think the only co-op change they made in this version is going back to two-player co-op instead of the four-player co-op offered by GoW 3.

I never used the four-player coop but I remember it now that you bring it up. One of the things I liked the most about GoW coop was when they would split you and your partner up and the different paths would intersect in strategic areas that would have players giving each other cover, manning turrets while the other is in a killing field, giving someone a longshot and sniper position to cover the other with. It really made it fun if you could communicate well with your teammate and your teammate was competent enough to understand a little strategy.

But you can get that experience in a lot of other co-op games. I'm not even sure what they could do to really evolve the series more at this point. I'm not in it for the story, the story is bad though I do enjoy some of the action sequences.
